ajay (Eng Manager): Quick Q — our London team has a local cultural celebration on 12/27 which overlaps company shutdown. Can folks use their floating holiday that week to observe?

maria (People Ops): short answer: yes, usually. need to check carryover + payroll cutoff. can you confirm dates?

ajay (Eng Manager): company shutdown 12/26-12/29. person wants 12/27 as local day. they have 1 floating day left from this year.

sarah (Payroll): FYI payroll cutoff for December final run is 12/20. if PTO is submitted after cutoff it still counts for headcount/time off but might not reflect on final paystub until Jan. not a blocker for approval though.

lina (HR Systems): floating holidays are tracked in WorkDay under "Floating Holiday" category. employee needs manager approval in the system and then to submit a ticket to people-ops if they want an exception to rollover rules.

maria (People Ops): policy refresher: floating holidays are intended for observance of local/cultural days. they expire at year-end unless you have an approved carryover (rare). for shutdown week we treat them like regular PTO — managers can approve.

ajay (Eng Manager): cool. any special step for aligning to company shutdown so they don't waste their floating day?

maria (People Ops): options: 1) they can use floating day 12/27 and regular shutdown days cover the rest. 2) if the local celebration is officially recognized in their country and they'd prefer a swap, we can approve a 1-day carryover if you file by 12/15 with a short justification. submit via the HR portal -> Time Off Exceptions.

sarah (Payroll): if you go the carryover route, notify payroll with the exception ID by 12/20 so it appears correctly on year-end reporting.

ajay (Eng Manager): I'll ask them which they prefer. sounds like filing by 12/15 is the safe move. thanks. :thumbsup:

maria (People Ops): yep — ping me if you need help drafting the justification. also note: contractors don't get floating holidays unless specified in their agreement.

jen_bot: reminder scheduled for 12/10: submit time-off exceptions for year-end carryover.

ajay (Eng Manager): noted, will coordinate. thanks everyone.

maria (People Ops): marking this resolved — reach out if the employee needs help with the portal or if this becomes a group request (we handle group exceptions differently). :sparkles:
